Class SshSessionController

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshSessionController
public class SshSessionController extends Object
The SshSessionController connects, disconnects, and reconnects one SSH session on a worker thread. The network work stays off the Swing event thread. The worker starts an Apache MINA SSHD client, which is the library that opens the SSH session. The same worker authenticates that session and opens a shell channel. A SshSessionController.Listener receives the result. TerminalSession moves that result onto the Swing event thread. disconnect() does not open another session. A remote close does not open another session either. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#SshSessionController

    • connect

      public void connect(SshSessionController.ConnectRequest request)
      The method starts a connect on a worker thread. The method returns at once when the state is not SshConnectionState.DISCONNECTED. A start clears the user-disconnect flag. The method calls SshSessionController.Listener.onConnecting() on the caller thread. The worker thread is named ssh-client-connect.
      Parameters:
      request - The request is the connection snapshot the worker uses.

      public void reconnect(SshSessionController.ConnectRequest request)

    • disconnectAndWait

      public void disconnectAndWait()
      The method closes the live connector on the caller thread and waits until that close returns. The method does not start a worker. The method does not call SshSessionController.Listener. TerminalSession.dispose() calls this method, and the window exit path calls dispose. The user-disconnect flag is set first so a remote-close callback from this close is ignored. The state becomes SshConnectionState.DISCONNECTED.

    • doConnect

      private void doConnect(SshSessionController.ConnectRequest request)
      The method opens the SSH session described by the request. The client is an Apache MINA SSHD client. The method checks the request with validateRequest(SshSessionController.ConnectRequest) before it uses the network. The method accepts every server key. The method applies the idle timeout and then starts the client. The method connects to the host and the port on the request. The connect waits up to 15 seconds. A null password is replaced with an empty string. Authentication waits up to 15 seconds. The shell channel uses a PTY, which is the remote terminal the server allocates. The PTY type comes from the session mode. The environment variable TERM is that same terminal type. The channel open waits up to 15 seconds. The method closes the channel, the session, and the client when the channel is not open. The method closes those same objects when the state is no longer connecting. Either of those closes stores no connector. If the state is still connecting after that close, the state becomes disconnected. That branch calls SshSessionController.Listener.onDisconnected(String) with null. A successful open stores an SshTtyConnector. The connector name is the username, an @, the host, a colon, and the port. The method then calls SshTtyConnector.tryAmwpInit(). A channel listener calls handleRemoteClose(Throwable) when the remote side closes the channel. SshSessionController.Listener.onConnected(SshTtyConnector, String, int) runs after that listener is installed. Any other failure is caught as Exception. The method closes the channel, the session, and the client. The method clears the connector and sets the state to disconnected. The method calls SshSessionController.Listener.onError(String) with the text from formatError(Exception).
      Parameters:
      request - The request is the connection snapshot this attempt uses.

    • handleRemoteClose

      private void handleRemoteClose(Throwable reason)
      The method handles a close that the remote side started. The method returns without a callback when the user-disconnect flag is set. The method returns without a callback when the state is already SshConnectionState.DISCONNECTED. Otherwise the method closes the live connector. The state becomes disconnected. A null reason uses the text Connection closed by remote host. Any other reason uses Connection closed: plus reason.getMessage().
      Parameters:
      reason - The reason is the SSHD close cause, and it may be null.

    • sendPaste

      public void sendPaste(String text) throws IOException
      The method writes the text as a bracketed paste. The method does not write Enter after the paste. A missing connector throws IOException with the text Not connected. A connector that is not connected throws that same exception. A null text is sent as an empty payload. The payload is encoded as UTF-8. The write begins with the bytes ESC[200~. The write ends with the bytes ESC[201~.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the payload, with newlines already normalized to \n.
      Throws:
      IOException - The exception is thrown when the connector is missing, the connector is not connected, or the write fails.

    • sendPasteAndSubmit

      public void sendPasteAndSubmit(String text) throws IOException
      The method sends a bracketed paste and then writes a carriage return. The paste editor calls sendPaste(String) and does not call this method. A connector that is gone after the paste does not receive the carriage return.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the payload passed to sendPaste(String).
      Throws:
      IOException - The exception is thrown when sendPaste(String) throws.

    • applyIdleTimeout

      private void applyIdleTimeout(org.apache.sshd.client.SshClient client, long idleTimeoutMs)
      The method sets the idle timeout on the SSH client. A timeout of 0 or less becomes a zero duration, and that duration does not disconnect for idle time. A positive timeout is that many milliseconds. The value is stored as the MINA IDLE_TIMEOUT on the client. // @aa-sdd G-23 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md
      Parameters:
      client - The client is the Apache MINA SSHD client that receives the timeout.
      idleTimeoutMs - The idle timeout is the limit in milliseconds, and 0 disables idle disconnect.

    • buildPtyConfiguration

      private org.apache.sshd.common.channel.PtyChannelConfiguration buildPtyConfiguration(SshSessionController.ConnectRequest request)
      The method builds the PTY type, the size, and the mode map for the shell channel. The PTY type is SshSessionMode.getTermType() for the mode on the request. A column count of 0 or less becomes 80. A row count of 0 or less becomes 24. The mode map is always the raw map from buildRawPtyModes(). ChatShell is the remote shell that does its own echo and line editing. Canonical echo would mangle a bracketed paste. ISIG would turn Ctrl+C into a PTY signal.
      Parameters:
      request - The request supplies the mode, the columns, and the rows.
      Returns:
      The return value is the SSHD PTY configuration for the shell channel.

    • buildRawPtyModes

      private Map<org.apache.sshd.common.channel.PtyMode, Integer> buildRawPtyModes()
      The method builds a raw PTY mode map. The map sets ECHO, ICANON, ISIG, IEXTEN, ECHOE, ECHOK, ECHOCTL, and OPOST to 0. The map sets CS8 to 1. Those flags let the program receive bracketed-paste wrappers and Ctrl+C as data.
      Returns:
      The return value is the mode map passed to the PTY configuration.

    • validateRequest

      private void validateRequest(SshSessionController.ConnectRequest request) throws IOException
      The method rejects a request that cannot be used on the network. An empty or blank host throws IOException with the text Host is required. An empty or blank username throws IOException with the text Username is required. A port below 1 or above 65535 throws IOException with the text Port must be between 1 and 65535.
      Parameters:
      request - The request is the snapshot to check.
      Throws:
      IOException - The exception is thrown when the host, the username, or the port is unusable.

    • formatError

      private String formatError(Exception ex)
      The method turns an exception into a short status string. A null or blank exception message uses Connection failed: plus the simple class name. Any other message uses Connection failed: plus that message.
      Parameters:
      ex - The exception is the failure to describe.
      Returns:
      The return value is the text shown for the failure.

    • closeQuietly

      private void closeQuietly(org.apache.sshd.client.channel.ChannelShell channel, org.apache.sshd.client.session.ClientSession session, org.apache.sshd.client.SshClient client)
      The method closes a half-open connect attempt and swallows close errors. A non-null channel is closed. A non-null session is closed. A non-null client is stopped. A null argument is skipped.
      Parameters:
      channel - The channel is the shell channel, and it may be null.
      session - The session is the client session, and it may be null.
      client - The client is the SSH client, and it may be null.

    • startWorker

      private void startWorker(String name, Runnable runnable)
      The method starts a daemon worker thread. The thread runs the work while it holds the worker lock. The lock keeps connect, disconnect, and reconnect from using the session at the same time.
      Parameters:
      name - The name is the thread name.
      runnable - The runnable is the work that runs under the lock.
